reviews.text: Rocky loves them!

Wonderful and easy experience with my dog that gets nervous at the groomer! They really listened to her needs and adapted so she felt comfortable. She looks so pretty, clean, and well groomed after the experience! I can tell they treat the dogs with kindness and respect which is very important during the groom. Hazel and I will be back!

I unfortunately didn’t get the name of the gentleman who groomed my baby, but that man is a WIZARD.

I brought in my goldendoodle and asked for a schnauzer cut. Not only did he absolutely nail it, but he somehow transformed my fluffy farm boy into a distinguished aristocrat. The grooming is flawless.

My only complaint is that my dog is now having an identity crisis and doesn’t know whether to continue being a farm boy or fully embrace his new role as a wealthy landowner. 💅🏽

10/10. Will absolutely be back.

I rarely leave reviews, but I’m extremely disappointed with my experience at Howlistic Grooming. This was my dog’s second visit, and before leaving him, they specifically asked if he would be receiving the same haircut as last time. I said yes and confidently left, expecting consistency with the previous groom.

Unfortunately, that was not the case at all. They cut my dog’s hair extremely low and completely ignored the previous grooming guidelines. When I expressed my dissatisfaction, I was told there was “nothing they could do” and that “for future reference” I should bring a photo. I didn’t think a photo was necessary for a repeat appointment when the staff made it seem like they already understood what was expected based on his last service.

The manager called the next day, listened to everything that happened, and ultimately only reiterated that they do not offer refunds or discounts. No apology, no empathy, and no accountability for the poor experience. The only response I kept hearing was “for future reference.”

To make matters worse, my dog’s ears were cut so short that he barely even looks like he has ears anymore. The haircut looks nothing like the previous groom, and it’s honestly upsetting to look at. Since the appointment, he hasn’t even seemed like his usual energetic self.

I trusted this salon to care for him properly, and instead I left feeling dismissed and deeply disappointed.

Photo 3: 4/1/2026

DO NOT GO HERE!!! The last time I took my 4 yr old Yorkie here, she came home limping. She wasn’t able to run or play for 2 weeks. I called to inform the manager, and the manage’s response to this was deciding that my dog could not come back. Worst experience I’ve ever had with a groomer!
Regina did an excellent job with my mini golden doodle! I always receive great, quick service and fair prices here. But she went over and beyond with his hair cut- thank you!
Super friendly staff, service provided was exceptional and best of all my puppy was super happy after his appointment that he didn’t even want to leave.
Good services reasonably priced.
She looks neat and short but I don’t think they know how to cut dogs hair of the ears

This is the only place I’ve ever felt comfortable bringing my dog for grooming.  The place is well run and they are good at communicating with you about any issues or for pick-up.  They do a really nice job and my little guy has always gotten a professional, fresh new look everytime he goes in. The location is great as it’s right off I-90 and there’s a 15 min loading zone in front for easy drop off.
The best with my Husky!  She is 13 and has hated grooming, no matter who does it but very much. Seems to love the team here and is by far her best experience!

Terrible business. They don’t take appointments and when I show up during their posted hours no one is there. Today is the second time in the last week or so I’ve shown up with my dog and the business is closed in the middle of the day with no sign or explanation.
Regina is the best of the best!!  She’s loving and patient with Lola !! 🐶 …
We’ve been bringing our dog to Howlistic for 4 years. Even though prices have gone up, we are willing to pay a little extra to know our fur baby is in good hands.

I’ve been taking my dogs here for years. I brought them in and always get the same thing always!!! This time I only got my boy dog fully groomed, but my girl dog I said just cut her face, she wears a ponytail so dont touch nothing but her face. don’t cut her ears. My daughter went to pick them up my girl dog is cut her ponytail is cut, her ears are also cut. I called and the groomer said she must’ve misunderstood me. I’m still upset but what can I do? I paid 170 and I’m disappointed.
Love the groomers here , appointments always available , customer service is good prices are good!
They always do a fantastic job and pay great attention to our requests and the needs of the dogs. They keep extensive notes of previous appointments which can be extremely helpful.
Love the service given and hospitality! Thank You!
Love this spot. So easy to get in. Staff is friendly. My mini golden doodle is always happy & they make her look so cute!
Very patient and caring workers who give each pet the time to get acclimated to them before starting grooming. My boy looks better than ever, and he always comes home happy and tail wagging!
Dropped off my stinky baby picked up a beautiful clean happy dog! I can’t believe I was wasting time at petco groomers I loved how she came back home! They are gentle yet effective dog groomers
They are literal miracle workers over there. My 130lb Cane Corso hates getting his nails clipped but they make it happen quickly and safely every month. 10/10
Regina takes great care of my dog keeps her looking great and makes her feel at ease when she is there.
I read the reviews and realized that my dog's frequent ear infections were caused by their operation. I usually only go to cut my dog's hair once every two weeks. But ear infections occur every time.

This is my first time ever having a dog professionally groomed and I’ve got to say, I’m sold. I’ve noticed changes around my home. Where I typically have to deep clean/change bedding/sweep/vacuum/wash floors every 5 days bc of noticeable fur and smells, after over a week of having the dogs here, my place seems as though dogs don’t even live here. Floors noticeably still clean, will probably change bedding just out of weekly habit, but not bc of any dog smells, and just have to say this was the only place that was easy to work with and for us in promptly! I called at least 10 other places to find that they either didn’t answer phones, emails, texts or simply had closed books. So was nice to have a place so close that had the capacity to take more clients. We’ll be back and highly recommend!

I’m not sure what’s going on at this groomers. I have been taking my fur babies here since they were weeks old and for some reason this time my money wasn’t well spent. My fur baby was rushed to be cleaned and still wet when I arrived to pick him up and not very cleaned. I must say this has never happened and also I never seen the people that worked there before. I’m a little confused and disappointed

Good experiences but expensive

I will saw I have had excellent experiences in the past at this location. Today I made an appointment for 2:30 PM (close at 4pm) which was a last-minute appointment. Upon entering, I was sent away because the worker on 7/28 has been there since 8 AM. Not impressed with customer service.
